summary: The customer called to complain about a three-week delay on an iPhone bundle delivery despite paying for express shipping. The agent apologized, explained there was a customs delay, and offered a shipping refund plus a free three-month data upgrade as compensation. The agent also confirmed the package left the warehouse and would arrive the next morning, leaving the customer fully satisfied.
